name: Stormfist

abilities.name: Left Cross
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Skyward Slam
abilities.description: The boss stomps, dealing moderate physical damage and knocking all players hit up into the air as indicated by a red circle.

abilities.name: Enervating Stone
abilities.description: The boss slams its fist into the ground, dealing moderate shock damage and stunning any players hit as indicated by a red circle.

abilities.name: Unstable Explosion
abilities.description: At 20% health, the boss releases lightning constantly dealing unavoidable moderate shock damage over time to all players until it is killed.

abilities.name: Summon Storm Atronachs
abilities.description: The boss will occasionally summon three Storm Atronachs to attack the party. These should be killed quickly to simplify the fight.

notes: He does not have a resting ball of lightning in his abdominal area connecting his top half to his bottom half like most storm atronachs, with it being empty instead.
related_quests: Eye of the Storm: Defeat the invading Maormer on Tempest Island.
Pledge: Tempest Island: Prove you are truly Undaunted by clearing Tempest Island.
summary: This article is about the creature. For the item set, see Stormfist (set). The Stormfist is a storm atronach found at Tempest Island, of which it is a boss. Its unique loot is the Tempestshield or Raining Hammer He is brought in by short-lived Maormer Summoners near the island's peak, and will summon smaller Storm Atronachs in waves of three.
